description: Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education - The universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 (Amendment) Order Under section.27(1) read with Section 21 - Eastern University of Sri Lanka.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order made under statutory powers (Section 27(1) read with Section 21) to amend the schedule establishing the Eastern University, Sri Lanka by adding a new department. While it mentions Minister Harini Amarasuriya, this is in her capacity as the authority making the legal order rather than focusing on her appointment or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about modifying the legal framework governing universities, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
